comment: Antigravity Sign Language Dataset Import Configuration

WLASL.name: Word-Level American Sign Language (WLASL) Video Dataset
WLASL.license: Computational Use Only / Academic Research License (Refer to WLASL repo)
WLASL.instructions: Download WLASL_v0.3.json and videos to data/import/wlasl/videos/ and set format to 'wlasl'

MS-ASL.name: Microsoft ASL (MS-ASL) Dataset
MS-ASL.instructions: Download MSASL_train.json / val.json and videos to data/import/msasl/ and set format to 'msasl'

FolderPerGloss.name: Custom Video / Keypoint Folder (Folder-per-gloss)
FolderPerGloss.instructions: Organize videos as data/import/custom/<gloss>/clip1.mp4, clip2.mp4 or json keypoint files. Set format to 'folder_per_gloss'
